RC1 · A REVIEW COPY FOR A BOARD MEMBER

Dear reader, would you read two chapters?

From the editor of The ultimate insider, a book about one day in which one person and a team of AI agents built a talk, with the record to prove it.

Why you
You chair the committee that would have to answer for an agent team like this one. If these chapters do not tell you what to ask your executives, they have missed the reader who most needs them.
What we would like
Two chapters, about 28 minutes, by Friday 13 November 2026 (an example date: nothing has been sent), and your answers to a few questions at the end of each.
What you get back
your name in the acknowledgements, if you want it there
the first edition when it ships
a reply to every comment, and a page showing what your comments changed
